description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData operation to query the real-time network bandwidth of a domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData查询域名实时网络带宽数据
name: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the carrier.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query the carrier name. If you do not set this parameter, data of all carriers is queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获取，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query the region name. If you do not set this parameter, data of all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域商英文名。

您可以调用[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获取，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的开始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
